Kimi will output JSON only. Should design FB with exact interface. Make sure assumptions and tests. Should think robust CODESYS ST.

I need declaration FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed VAR_INPUT all etc VAR_OUTPUT, VAR internal. No END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. implementation ST body. supporting_objects likely [] no DUT needed. Should use helper function? avoid.

I need implement modes, edge, reset, phases 1..8, busy. Initial next_step 1, busy false. Should have initialization for prevStart and mode tracking. Each test resets instance: internal defaults. Can declare phase : INT := 1; xBusy : BOOL := FALSE; xPrevStart etc; xPrevMode : INT :=0; xInitialized perhaps not needed. Mode reset transitions.

Semantics careful:
- EmergencyStop FALSE cancels sequence outputs. Recovery fresh Start edge from top-left. Fresh edge computed Start AND NOT prevStart. During e-stop update prevStart at end. If Start held during e-stop and released after? recovery requires fresh Start edge, so no start. Good.
- no selected mode outputs off sequence reset. Changing mode reset sequence. Mode current encode 0 none, 1 manual, 2 step,3 single,4 cont. On first call selected mode differs prev 0, resets (already default). PrevMode update every scan including e-stop/no mode.
- Start rising edge history updates always, including active ignored.
- Single-step: each new step requires fresh Start; initial action requires top-left at action 1. Later steps no pose. Tests: after completion busy false, phase advanced to 2. Held start doesn't trigger. start false then true triggers grip. Good.
- Single cycle start in idle busy false and phase=1, top-left. Starts busy and outputs down same scan. Continuous likewise.
- cycle modes one phase transition per invocation, completion feedback switches to next command same scan. On active phase with feedback true, advance phase and output based new phase. If next command limit already active, output suppressed but processed completion next invocation. Should implement using pre-phase completion then set phase, then command generation. Not loop. At start, should not process completion same scan? Start from idle sets busy true phase 1, then command down. Even if DownLimitSwitch true? top-left and down limit contradictory outside contract. But at continuous wrap left completion with DownLimitSwitch false in tests outputs down. If DownLimitSwitch true at wrap output down false, next scan completion advances grip. Good.
- single-step completion: pre-busy and feedback -> busy false, advance phase (wrap to 1 after 8), output off. Next action fresh start later scan. If not busy and no rising start outputs off. If start accepted sets busy true and outputs current phase, no completion processing same scan. Make sure step 1 pose check. At step 8 completion phase wraps 1 and idle; next start requires top-left. Good.
- Single-cycle left completion -> busy false, phase 1, outputs off. Continuous left completion -> busy remains true, phase 1, outputs down gated.
- emergency priority and mode changes reset.
- manual commands combinational and limits. Opposing both inhibited. MoveDown := DownButton AND NOT UpButton AND NOT DownLimitSwitch. MoveUp := UpButton AND NOT DownButton AND NOT UpLimitSwitch. Left similar, right. Grip pair. Independent non-opposing can run together. P4 limits suppress outputs in auto too via gating.
- Auto command generation phase mapping 1 down,2 grip,3 up,4 right,5 down,6 release,7 up,8 left.
- Completion based pre-action. Should use xFeedback BOOL internal perhaps set case. xStartEdge, xMode, xPrevMode, xPhase, xBusy, xPrevStart, xActionDone? I can structure clean.

Implementation:

xStartEdge := Start AND NOT xPrevStart;
xPrevStart := Start; // history update immediate okay
xMode := 0;
IF ManualMode THEN xMode:=1; ELSIF ... (mutually exclusive).
outputs reset first.

IF NOT EmergencyStop THEN
 xPhase:=1; xBusy:=FALSE; xPrevMode:=xMode; RETURN;
END_IF;

IF xMode=0 THEN reset; prevMode=0; RETURN; END_IF;

IF xMode <> xPrevMode THEN
 xPhase:=1; xBusy:=FALSE;
 xPrevMode:=xMode;
 // Should I allow start same scan mode change? Assumption changing mode resets sequence. Could still process start? Typically reset then same scan can process. Tests first call Start false. Not specified. Better after reset continue, allowing start in new mode if edge and top-left. Reasonable. If RETURN then first start with mode selection lost. Not ideal. Continue.
END_IF;

IF xMode=1 THEN manual; xBusy false xPhase1; RETURN.

Automatic:
IF NOT xBusy THEN
  IF xStartEdge THEN
    IF (xMode=2 AND xPhase<>1) OR ((xPhase=1) AND UpLimitSwitch AND LeftLimitSwitch) THEN
      xBusy:=TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
ELSE
  // determine done for current phase
  xFeedback := FALSE;
  CASE xPhase OF ... down both 1,5 DownLimitSwitch; 2 grip;3,7 up;4 right;6 release;8 left.
  IF xFeedback THEN
    IF xMode=2 THEN xBusy false; advance phase/wrap.
    ELSIF xPhase=8 THEN
      xPhase:=1;
      IF xMode=3 THEN xBusy false; ELSE busy true; END_IF
    ELSE xPhase:=xPhase+1;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_IF;

IF xBusy THEN case phase output gated END_CASE END_IF.

Question single-step start phase 1 initial top-left requirement. Conditional above for xPhase=1 requires top-left for all automatic. For phases 2-8 single step accepts. Single cycle/single cont phase always1 idle. Fine.
When automatic idle and no start, off.
When busy and done single step, busy false, phase advances and off.
Cycle transition output next same scan.
Start edge during active ignored since only in not busy. Edge history updated. Good.
E-stop changes prevMode to xMode. Sequence reset. Upon release, no mode change. Start fresh needed. If Start press in same scan as emergency release, xStartEdge true and top-left start allowed. fine.
No mode resets phase. Mode change while Start high: xStartEdge could be false if held, so no auto restart. good.
Initial xPrevStart default false. If first invocation Start true automatic starts. Good.

Declaration syntax:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
...
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT...
END_VAR
VAR
    xPhase : INT := 1;
    xBusy : BOOL := FALSE;
    xPrevStart : BOOL := FALSE;
    xPrevMode : INT := 0;
    xMode : INT;
    xStartEdge : BOOL;
    xFeedback : BOOL;
END_VAR

Exact interface names/types. supporting_objects []. Is initialized VAR supported CODESYS 3.5 yes.

Potential tests model initial next_step 1 busy false perhaps names not required. No need expose.

Could use RETURN; in FB implementation allowed CODESYS. Yes.

Should consider P4 globally: outputs all reset when e-stop, no mode. Manual and auto gating. Good.

One nuance xPrevMode initial 0 and first call Manual sets reset. Fine.

One nuance emergency while Start true then no Start edge on release. prevStart updated before e-stop. Good.

One nuance no mode with Start true, later select mode while Start still true no edge. good.

Could simplify avoid helper. JSON string newline escaping. Only object. Ensure declaration omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. implementation body alone no comments needed. supporting objects [].

Should check single cycle test step 5: prephase up1 busy, UpLimit true => phase4 right, output MoveRight = not RightLimit. yes.
step6 prephase right, RightLimit true => phase5 down, DownLimit false => MoveDown true. yes.
step7 prephase down2 DownLimit true => release output true because ReleaseLimit false. yes.
step8 release feedback true => up2 output true UpLimit false. yes.
step9 up2 feedback true => left output true left limit false. yes.
step10 left feedback true => idle off. good.

Continuous same wrap down.

Single step test:
call1 no busy phase1 start false.
call2 start edge busy down output.
call3 start held prebusy down, DownLimit false no feedback, output down.
call4 DownLimit true done -> busy false phase2 off.
call5 held start no edge off.
call6 Start false off.
call7 start true edge phase2 -> grip output.
call8 Start false, prebusy grip GripLimit true -> busy false phase3 off.
call9 Start true rising from false -> up output. yes.

Manual e-stop etc.

Should I enforce automatic start top-left when single-step initial after wrap only. yes.

Recovery requires verified top-left pose. emergency reset busy false phase1, start only top-left. Good.

No selected mode all off and sequence reset. Changing mode resets. In manual I reset every scan. Fine.

Potential issue mode change to single-step while xStartEdge and Start pressed same scan accepted after reset. reasonable.

"Only one phase transition occurs per invocation." My start isn't transition? Start action 1 same. completion only one. Good.

"already-active next limit suppresses its command but is processed as completion on next invocation." yes because no loop.

"At start of a new automatic sequence (action 1, not every individual single step)" Wording could mean top-left only action1, which is first single step; okay.

No standard lib needed.

Could use USINT instead INT fine internal.

Output JSON with declaration and implementation. Should be valid JSON. Respond.
